Measured argon flow is 100.6 sccm against a 100.0 sccm setpoint.
Exhaust oxygen is 2.4 ppm and has remained low throughout growth.
Heater power is 44.7%, consistent with recent steady growth readings.
Pressure gauge is not installed; pressure readings are unavailable, so growth pressure and possible exhaust restriction cannot be verified.
